system.concept: Disgraced Tremere Apprentice Turned Anarch Occult Sage
system.biography:
Roleplaying Hints

A rebellious occultist, radical theologian and part-time prophet in life, you caught the Warlocks' eye early on, and after a suitable period of time you were approached for the Embrace. Contrary to the meritocracy you'd been promised, however, it took long decades to rise through the pyramid to just a mid-ranking apprentice for your local chantry. You bided your time, waiting for an opportunity to prove your worth to rise to Regent. At last it came, and with no small amount of triumphant glee, you presented evidence proving the local Regent had become Blood Bound to an outsider and was giving orders that violated the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Oath. Unfortunately, you had no idea that the canny old Regent had been tracking your movements for some time. She managed to turn the accusation back against you as a vile slander to cover up for your own crimes against the clan (carefully manufactured in advance, of course). Even after all that time, you'd been outmaneuvered—it was your word against the Regent's. Naturally, you never had a chance. Knowing what must be in store for you, you bolted, taking only your ritual clothes and the few tomes you had borrowed from the library. Luck finally went your way, and you managed to escape, eventually falling in with the anarchs. They mistrust you and you're fine with that—after the experiences you suffered at the hands of your own clan, you can understand why they're a little skittish. But they seem closer than anyone to establishing the meritocracy you've sought throughout life and undeath, and for that kind of goal you're willing to be patient. As it is, they generally leave you alone to do research and only call on you to play the role of the wise occult sage when something strange happens. What troubles you is that, while certainly more versed in the occult and bizarre than most anarchs, you also learned just enough to realize there's a lot more out there than you understand. That more than anything frightens you every time you get a call demanding your “expertise.”

Stat Block (as printed)

Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}
Nature: Thrill-Seeker
Demeanor: Competitor
Generation: 11th

Physical (9): Brutal, Enduring, Nimble x2, Quick x2, Steady, Tough x2
Social (10): Alluring x2, Beguiling, Dignified x2, Empathic, Eloquent, Ingratiating x2, Persuasive, Condescending (N)
Mental (11): Alert, Cunning, Knowledgeable x3, Determined, Disciplined x3, Rational x2

Abilities: Academics (Theology) x4, Occult x3, Awareness x2, Linguistics x3 (Latin, Greek and Hebrew), Medicine, Melee, Science x2, Subterfuge, Dodge x2

Disciplines: Auspex (Heightened Senses, Aura Perception, Spirit's Touch, Telepathy); Thaumaturgy: Path of Blood (Taste for Blood, Blood Rage, Blood of Potency); Rituals (Deflection of the Wooden Doom, Principal Focus of Vitae Infusion, Wake With Evening's Freshness, Ward Versus Vitae)

Backgrounds: Resources x2, Retainers, Influence: Occult x3
Merits: Lucky, Oracular Ability
Flaws: Phobia, Probationary Sect Member
Virtues: Conscience 2, Self-Control 3, Courage 2
Path: Humanity 3
Reputation: Committed, Hook-Up
Blood: 12 (may spend 1/round)
Willpower: 4

system.description: You may double the range of your sight and hearing and sharpen your other senses to remarkable acuity, perceiving things ordinary folk cannot. A sudden sensory assault, such as a loud noise or strong odor, numbs the affected sense for the rest of the scene and stuns you for a turn unless you spend a Willpower Trait. You may also receive uncontrollable visions of past or future events.

By concentrating on a visible subject and besting them in a Static Mental Challenge, you read the colors of their aura to learn their emotional state, general nature, whether they're under magical influence, have committed diablerie, or just lied; it can also reveal nearby ghosts.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

system.description: Maintain physical contact with an object or location and concentrate for a turn, expending a Mental Trait, then ask the Narrator one question about who last touched it, whether it was involved in stressful situations, or what strong emotions drove its user. May be used repeatedly for greater insight; objects of powerful emotional resonance may force a derangement upon the user for the scene.

items.name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 1 Basic — A Taste for Blood

system.description: By tasting a single Blood Trait of a subject's vitae, you learn how much blood remains in their system, how recently they fed, their generation, and whether they are a diablerist.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 1 Basic — Blood Rage

system.description: By gaining a firm touch on a subject (possibly via a Physical Challenge), you force them to expend a single Blood Trait in any fashion you mentally dictate, even beyond their normal limits.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

items.name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 2 Intermediate — Blood of Potency

system.description: By concentrating your vitae for the scene or an hour, you spend two Mental Traits per generation (up to three generations) to gain a temporary, more potent virtual generation, raising your Blood Trait maximum and Dominate's reach.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
